job: State what the product does on the first screen, with one primary action and one line of proof.
purpose: The first section: a display title, a lead, one primary and one quiet action, a note, and in some variants a media frame holding a real product specimen. Variants differ in structure: the headline alone, the headline beside the product, the product under the headline, or one centred column.
useWhen: The top of a landing page or a product page.

avoidWhen.when: A closing band near the end of the page.
The head of an app page.
A launch announcement inside the app.

variants.useWhen: The headline is the picture: no media, a rule under the title. The home of the texture ground.
Text and a product frame side by side.
Text, then a full-width frame beneath it that ends inside the section.
Stack only: the frame runs past the section's bottom and its cut edge fades into the ground; only when the frame's bottom holds nothing a reader needs.
A launch or a manifesto; once on a site at most.

parts.role: The frame: an fd-doc-frame holding an fd-site-shot.
One line of proof under the actions.

relation.because: A hero opens a public page and carries its headline; an announcement is an accent block for news inside the product.
